edges.reason: Constructor assigns the initial base URI state variable.
Constructor assigns the initial not-revealed URI state variable.
mint uses msg.sender for balance checks, minting and event emission.
signatureClaim uses msg.sender for balance checks and signed claim validation.
msg.sender is bound to the signed message hash as caller.
mint requires the paused flag to be false.
mint requires saleIsActive to be true.
mint requires onlyWhitelisted to be false.
mint checks msg.value against cost * _mintAmount.
mint enforces the per-address maxMintAmount cap.
mint reads and increments addressMintedBalance.
mint enforces totalSupply() + _mintAmount <= maxSupply.
mint forwards the collected ETH to the internal payout function pay.
User-supplied msg.value flows into the native transfer payout operation, enabling reentrant value calls.
pay executes payable().transfer() native transfers that hand control to recipients.
mint calls _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received on the recipient contract.
signatureClaim calls _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received on the recipient contract.
reserveNfts calls _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received.
signatureClaim requires saleIsActive to be true.
signatureClaim requires onlyWhitelisted to be true.
signatureClaim checks msg.value against cost * _mintAmount.
signatureClaim enforces the maxMintAmount cap.
signatureClaim enforces the maxSupply cap.
signatureClaim reads and increments addressMintedBalance.
signatureClaim calls the internal signature validator.
_validateSignature compares the recovered address to signerAddress.
_validateSignature reaches the ecrecover based recovery routine.
setOffset derives the offset value from block.timestamp (weak randomness).
setOffset performs the timestamp modulo derivation operation.
block.timestamp is the input to the offset derivation operation.
The timestamp-derived value is written into the offset state variable.
tokenURI shifts the token id using the offset variable.
tokenURI uses maxSupply as the modulo modulus for the shift.
tokenURI branches on the revealed flag.
tokenURI returns notRevealedUri while unrevealed.
tokenURI concatenates baseURI with the shifted token id.
_baseURI returns the baseURI state variable.
tokenURI calls _baseURI to build the metadata URI.
reveal sets the revealed flag to true.
setBaseURI writes the new base URI state variable.
setNotRevealedURI writes the unrevealed URI state variable.
pause updates the paused flag.
setSaleState updates the saleIsActive flag.
setWhitelist updates the onlyWhitelisted flag.
reserveNfts turns whitelist mode on after the owner reserve mint.
returnWhitelist reads the onlyWhitelisted flag.
returnSale reads the saleIsActive flag.
royaltyInfo falls back to royaltyAddress when no token receiver is set.
royaltyInfo uses ROYALTY_SIZE as the royalty numerator.
royaltyInfo uses ROYALTY_DENOMINATOR as the royalty denominator.
royaltyInfo reads _royaltyReceivers for the given token id.
ROYALTY_SIZE participates in the royalty amount multiplication.
ROYALTY_DENOMINATOR participates in the royalty amount division.
royaltyInfo performs _salePrice*ROYALTY_SIZE/ROYALTY_DENOMINATOR arithmetic.
addRoyaltyReceiverForTokenId writes into the _royaltyReceivers mapping.
setProvenanceHash writes the one-time provenance hash.
walletOfOwner relies on the balance accounting derived from addressMintedBalance driven mints.
